charger.topology: 1S synchronous switching charger + NVDC power path
charger.selection_reason: mainland switching NVDC charger with very low battery IQ; non-D variant keeps USB D+/D- exclusively on ESP32-S3
charger.input_detection: Non-D SGM41513 has VAC + PSEL + nPG, no D+/D- pins. PSEL high selects 500mA default; host may program IINDPM over I2C.

psel_policy.reason: safe fixed default for passive Type-C sink without Rp-current detection

gauge.selection_reason: lower active current than CW2217 while retaining current sensing and portable-device fuel-gauge architecture

fallback.reason: better current-sense documentation / current LCSC listing, but higher IQ

aon_buckboost.max_current_note: 3.5A at VIN>=2.7V,VOUT=3.5V; sufficient headroom for 3.3/3.4V AON study
aon_buckboost.startup: ADDR high gives 3.4V startup; firmware lowers to 3.3V after boot
aon_buckboost.selection_reason: dramatically lower IQ than SGM62118 while preserving buck/boost and higher transient headroom
qualification: 3.4V startup compatibility of every AON load

usb_c.mode: USB2 device, 5V sink only, no PD/PPS
usb_c.source_current_policy: PSEL high gives 500mA autonomous limit; firmware may raise IINDPM only after a future validated source-capability policy
usb_c.vbus_status: SGM41513 status/IRQ instead of TUSB320/TPS3700 path

replacements.U202-U205: removed by passive Type-C + charger status architecture

load_switch_policy.reason: official SGM2578S/SD reverse-current protection is specified when disabled; incumbent contract requires full-time reverse current blocking while enabled
load_switch_policy.decision: retain TPS22916 until a mainland part proves enabled-state full-time RCB or redesign each domain backfeed contract

deep_sleep_typical_ua.note: component-only comparison; whole-device leakage and switched-domain leakage remain bench qualification

rejected_or_secondary.reason: orderable generic device uses 100mA-1A linear charging; compact 1A charging creates unacceptable thermal risk without derating; retain as research alternative only
switching charger but available evidence does not beat SGM41513 low battery IQ / I2C / BC1.2 / JEITA fit
valid 18uA buck-boost, superseded by SGM62125 2.25uA for C4 low-power baseline
disabled-only reverse-current protection does not meet TPS22916 full-time-RCB contract
